basis: Stanford program inception predates its 1918 Pacific Coast Conference entry.
Stanford Athletics/Pac history: Stanford joined the Pacific Coast Conference in 1918; PCC dissolved after 1958-59.
AAWU formed in 1959 with Stanford as an original member.
AAWU adopted the Pacific-8 name for 1968-69; Stanford season records use Pac-8.
Conference expanded/named Pacific-10 beginning 1978-79; Stanford season records use Pac-10.
Pac-12 naming era begins 2011-12; 2023-24 was Stanford's final Pac-12 season.
Stanford accepted ACC membership beginning August 2024; 2024-25 was its inaugural ACC basketball season.
